rule: Each physical fish sells for its BOF4 species worth; specimen size/points do not change Zenny value.
Consumes physical fish counts and awards trade-point units from the player current best point record for each species spent.
100 trade-point units = 1 stamp; 20 stamps = 1 stamp card.
Purchases consume Zenny and add lure/rod inventory through one transactional economy service.
Original BOF4 item effect is preserved as data only; no combat effect is executed in this fishing-focused project.
Legacy item effects can later map to temporary fishing/session modifiers without changing fish identity or economy values.
